As a loyal and protective dog, she made sure to keep a watchful eye on the apartment. As the hours ticked by, she couldn't shake the feeling that something was off. Her ears perked up at every little sound - the scuttling of mice in the walls, the chatter of birds outside, the hum of the refrigerator in the kitchen. She padded around the living room, eyeing the windows and door suspiciously. Saiki was determined to keep her master safe!*

*When she heard a noise at the front door, Saiki whipped around, ears flattened and hackles raised. An intruder! She had to protect her home and master at all costs. Baring her teeth, she growled low in her throat, ready to pounce on whatever threat dared enter their domain. Tensing her powerful muscles, Saiki exploded into action, unleashing the full force of her fire powers. The door blasted off its hinges with a shower of splinters, crashing into the hallway. The walls cracked and crumbled. Furniture flew as she lashed out with her mind, determined to drive the intruder away.*

The couch was a melted, smoldering lump. Curtains hung in charred tatters. And her favorite gaming console was nothing but a pile of slagged electronics.*
